prompt: Support agents speak English, but customers write in Spanish, Japanese and German.
tells: customers write in Spanish, Japanese and German
why: Azure Translator converts text between languages.
trap: Nothing needs transcribing; it's already text.

prompt: Incoming tickets arrive in many languages, and each must be routed to the team that speaks it.
tells: routed to the team that speaks it
why: Language detection, usually the first step of translation, identifies which language each ticket is in.
trap: No entities or topics needed; just which language.

prompt: A conference keynote in French needs live English subtitles.
why: Speech translation turns spoken French into English text.
trap: Plain speech to text would give French captions.

prompt: Translate a whole folder of Word manuals into Portuguese while keeping their formatting.
why: Document translation keeps layout while translating.
trap: Extraction pulls fields; this converts the whole document.

prompt: Ship the app's help articles in 12 languages without hiring translators for each.
why: Azure Translator converts text between languages.
trap: Nothing needs to be spoken or condensed.

prompt: Machine translation keeps turning the brand name 'Contoso Cloud' into local words. It must stay unchanged.
why: Translator supports custom glossaries and do-not-translate terms.
trap: Recognizing the name as an entity doesn't stop it being translated.

prompt: A tour guide speaks Italian, and tourists hear the words in Japanese through an app.
tells: tourists hear the words in Japanese
why: Speech translation goes from spoken Italian to Japanese.
trap: Text to speech is only the last step; the core is translation.

prompt: Messages arrive in unknown languages; each must be translated to English without the sender saying which language they used.
tells: without the sender saying which language they used
why: Translator detects the source language automatically.
trap: Detection here is part of translating, not a separate goal.
